provenance.sourceFixture: Task 1 runtime metrics plus production WorkflowService visual comparison
provenance.method: Thirty distinct controlled UI deliveries execute real WorkflowService status, reviewer submission, visual comparison, repair, and reviewer invalidation paths. Five deterministic first failures repair to new packets and pass. A manual monotonic clock supplies reviewer event durations; host wall time is not a decision input.
provenance.sanitization: Only aggregate counts, rates, deterministic wall durations, bounded fixture metadata, and SHA-256 aggregate digests are persisted.

fixture.firstFailureRule: Every sixth delivery fails its first packet; one failure per workload.
fixture.repairRule: Each first failure changes implementation source and produces a new passing packet.

measurementDefinitions.reviewerWallStartedBeforeVisualStability: Sum of functional reviewer action wall time because every measured functional action was exposed by current status before its packet had a numeric visual pass.
measurementDefinitions.totalReviewerWallMs: Sum of review.wall_ms emitted by real functional and design review completion or invalidation events.
measurementDefinitions.invalidatedReviewerWallMs: Sum of review.invalidated_wall_ms emitted when a real repairable visual failure reopened implementation and reset exposed reviewer work.
measurementDefinitions.passToBothReviewsWallMs: Manual-clock elapsed duration from real visual pass completion until both applicable real reviewer submissions completed.
